title: This is Amazing! "Xvive U35 Wireless System" product Review

5.8 GHz True Diversity wireless system for dynamic microphones

24-bit / 48 kHz digital audio with low distortion and wide frequency response

Stable 5.8 GHz wireless connection with a range of up to 100 feet (30.5 m)
Mic Mode for dynamic microphones and Line Mode for wireless audio from a mixer to a powered speaker
